Also do you move somebody back from the sides of a saf or from the middle. 3451 views Q. I am a 33 year old Indian male from Mumbai, staying in workig in Abu Dhabi. I have pproximately 20-22 years of Qada namaz. I came across a site called www.islamicacademy.com giving the following easy way of praying For the people who have many years of missed Salahs. There is a way to pray them quickly. Following instructions have four exeptions and has all Fards and Wajibs for a complete Salat. Please pray your Qaza as soon as possible. Even of you could pray one days Qaza Salahs every day which are only 20 rakahs (3 wajib witr), please do it. It only takes few mins to perform 20 rakahs according to the following instructions. 1) In Ruku and Sajdah instead of reciting "Subhaana Rabbiyal Azeem" and "Subhaana Rabbiyal A'la" three times, say it only once. But make sure do not leave Ruku poster untill the Meem (M) of Azeem has been said properly. Similarly do not leave the posture of Sajdah until Ala has been said completely. Just make sure to say these Tasbeehaat properly and do not rush. 2) In third and four Rakah of Fard Salah instead of reciting the whole Soorah Fatiha say, "Subhan Allah" three times and go to Ruku, . Make sure "Subhan Allah" has been recited three times properly, do not rush. This exeption is only for Fard. In third rakah of Witr it's a must to recite full Soorah Fatiha followed by at least three ayahs of Quran or a soorah (as we usually do in first and second rakah). 3) In last Qaidah (when we sit for Attahyyat) before Salam, after Attahyyat instead of full Durood and Dua just say, "Allah Humma Salle Ala Sayedena Mohammad Wa Aalihi", then finish the Salat with Salam. Dua is not a must here. 4) In Witr, instead of full Dua-e-Qunoot just say "Rabbigh Fir Lee" one or three times. (Fatawa Rizvia, Part 3, Page 622) Can you please advise if the above method can be followed sagely 2924 views Q. Validity of Salah with tight leggings/ chudidars for women. 14533 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 147865 Country: India Title: Ruling pertaining to Qasr namaz Question: If someone travels from his residence city to his native village which is e.g. more than 100 km away there he offers four rakats of Zuhr, Asr and Isha, then while retaining to his residing city, he stays for less than 15 days in his wife's village which is e.g. 25/30 km away from his native village then how many rakats he must perform in Zuhr etc? Answer ID: 147865 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 446/455/H=5/1438) Your in-laws’ home (house of wife’s parents) is not like a native place for you. However, if the city you are residing in is 25 or 30 kms from the place of in-laws and you go there to stay less than fifteen days, then too you shall offer full salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
